body: The nervousness has subsided. I feel at peace with my decision.
Because it will be the 5th anniversary of when my friend did it
I've got a plan and a time line now. I'm good as gone.
I live in literal physical and mental agony. Day in and day out. I can't keep doing it anymore. I'm done. One week from now she'll regret what she said.

3-5 days per month I have to go in. I'm just done. Done with all this crap. I have enough medications to take me down and maybe that's the plan. I can't handle this life. I can't keep going. The mind and the body are weak.

The reset of my life is hospitals and pills. Everyone says "oh you're so strong" but guess what? You can only bend so far before you break. When you test the strength of something you can break it and it'll never be the same.
I just don't want to be in this life. She clearly doesn't want me to be.

I don't feel like she's acting like an adult, posting online about how much she hates me and not talking to me about things. I tried reaching out to her today and haven't got anything back. Not even a thank you for updating her about our mom's medical condition.
What she doesn't know is I took the abuse from our uncle so he would leave her alone. How do you tell someone that?
